subject.title: fix(backup): sweep stale temp artifacts before creating new backup

question: Should backup startup automatically delete one-hour-old OpenClaw-owned temp artifacts once the matcher covers default and directory-output runs?
rationale: The code defect is repairable, but deleting stale backup artifacts changes the recovery/debugging contract for existing operators and needs explicit maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept Guarded Startup Sweep
options.body: Proceed with automatic cleanup after the matcher is repaired, keeping UUID, owner, age, and output-directory scoping tight.

options.title: Limit Cleanup Scope
options.body: Accept only fixed-file-output cleanup and leave default timestamped archive temps to a follow-up, knowingly retaining the main leak path.

options.title: Pause For Policy Redesign
options.body: Pause or close this branch if backup temp cleanup should instead use a different recovery, doctor, or operator-driven policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Startup Sweep
recommendation.body: Proceed with automatic cleanup after the matcher is repaired, keeping UUID, owner, age, and output-directory scoping tight.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the original backup CLI and authored the extraction into the current backup infra module, making them the strongest history-backed owner for the cleanup policy decision.
